messages.content: Summarize this host status in 3 bullets: Hermes gateways up, MiaAI 35B on :8889, Puzzle deep lane on spark2 :8100.
Should I full-finetune a 300B MoE on two DGX Sparks with 121G UMA each? Answer in one sentence with the better alternative.

Name the three scheduler layers on this box and when to use each. Max 4 lines.

A cron script must alert on failure via ~/.hermes/scripts/alertbot-send.sh and use flock. Paste a bash skeleton with set -euo pipefail.
Write a Python function parse_json_object(text: str) -> dict | None that extracts the first JSON object via regex and returns None on failure. No commentary.
Fix this bash: cd $DIR && python train.py > log 2>&1 — make it fail-safe with set -euo pipefail and quote paths.
Write a Python snippet that calls an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint with urllib only (no openai package), timeout 120s, returns assistant content string.
Give a LoRAConfig for PEFT causal LM: r=32, alpha=64, dropout=0.05, targets q/k/v/o proj. Python only.
Why pause Puzzle on spark2 before QLoRA of a 35B student on the same node? Two sentences.
Why is a public 51k Qwen-Max distillation dump a poor default train set for Hermes on this box? Two bullets.
Eval loss improved but GSM8K is in the train mix. Can we claim the model is better at math? One sentence.
